params.name: DBClusterIdentifier
params.reason: Restricts results to snapshots for this DB cluster.

params.name: DBClusterSnapshotIdentifier
params.reason: Restricts results to the specified snapshot.

params.name: DbClusterResourceId
params.reason: Restricts results to the specified DB cluster resource.

params.name: IncludePublic
params.reason: Includes public snapshots, which are excluded by default.

params.name: IncludeShared
params.reason: Includes shared snapshots, which are excluded by default.

params.name: SnapshotType
params.reason: Restricts results to the specified snapshot type.

reason: Each parameter selects the snapshots returned or whether a snapshot category is included.
